page.title: AI Agents
page.subtitle: Specialist agents that research, plan and analyze for {{organization}}.
page.safety: Agents only read data and propose. Nothing is published, created or spent in any ad account from this screen.
page.noAccessTitle: You don't have access to AI Agents
page.noAccessBody: Ask an administrator of this organization to give your role the agents:read permission.
page.readOnly: You can view agents, tasks and results, but your role cannot start or cancel tasks.

state.unavailableTitle: AI Agents is unavailable right now
state.unavailableBody: The server did not answer. Nothing is shown instead of guessing. Try again in a moment.

noCredential.title: No AI provider key is configured
noCredential.body: Agents need a provider key of this organization to call a model.

noModel.title: No AI model is enabled
noModel.body: Add and enable a model so agents can run.

noRoute.title: Some agents have no model route
noRoute.body: Choose a model for the agents that show "No AI model", or set a default route.

budgetReached.title: AI spending limit reached
budgetReached.body: The {{period}} limit of this organization is used up, so new model calls are blocked until it resets or is raised.

googleMissing.title: No Google Ads account is connected
googleMissing.body: Agents that read account data will answer that it is unavailable, and their results stay hypotheses until an account is connected.

catalog.title: Supervisor and specialists
catalog.subtitle: The supervisor splits a request into steps and delegates to the specialists. Each specialist only has the read-only tools listed on its card.
catalog.supervisorNote: The supervisor cannot be disabled; choose its model through its route in the AI Control Center.

product_analyst.name: Product and sales-page analyst
product_analyst.description: Analyzes a product and its sales page: value propositions, audience hypotheses, objections and claims to verify.
product_analyst.readiness: operational: real model + catalog + deterministic analysis of the public sales page (what it states, what is missing)

market_researcher.name: Market and keyword researcher
market_researcher.description: Proposes themes, keyword candidates (hypotheses, or Keyword Planner estimates when available) and negative keywords.
market_researcher.readiness: operational with a connected Google Ads account (Keyword Planner estimates + real search terms); hypotheses only without one

search_ads_strategist.name: Google Search Ads strategist
search_ads_strategist.description: Designs a Search campaign structure (campaigns, ad groups, themes), bidding approach and measurement plan.
search_ads_strategist.readiness: operational for planning, grounded on the connected account's real structure/performance and Keyword Planner estimates when available; creates nothing in Google Ads

ad_copywriter.name: Ad copywriter (responsive search ads)
ad_copywriter.description: Writes Responsive Search Ad headlines (30 chars) and descriptions (90 chars) per ad group.
ad_copywriter.readiness: operational: real model + deterministic validation of limits and editorial rules

policy_reviewer.name: Policy and compliance reviewer
policy_reviewer.description: Reviews ad text and claims for policy/compliance risks and recommends changes.
policy_reviewer.readiness: operational as an advisory reviewer (static rules + model judgment); not an official Google Ads policy decision

performance_analyst.name: Optimization and performance analyst
performance_analyst.description: Analyzes measured Google Ads performance (and data supplied with the task) and proposes hypotheses and experiments.
performance_analyst.readiness: operational with a connected Google Ads account (real measured metrics); otherwise analyzes only data supplied by the requester

supervisor.name: Agent supervisor
supervisor.description: Plans the work, delegates to specialists, controls execution and consolidates the results.
supervisor.readiness: operational: planning and consolidation through the AI Gateway

product_analyst.0: Pages that need JavaScript to render are read as served (no browser rendering).
product_analyst.1: The analysis reports what the page SAYS; it does not verify that the claims are true.

market_researcher.0: Keyword Planner figures are Google's estimates (monthly averages, top-of-page bid ranges), not measurements; detail depends on the account and developer-token level.
market_researcher.1: Without a connected Google Ads account every keyword is a hypothesis with no volume or cost.

search_ads_strategist.0: Plans are proposals; creating them in an account needs Google Ads write tools plus human approval (not part of this stage).
search_ads_strategist.1: Without a connected Google Ads account the plan rests on hypotheses and supplied data.

ad_copywriter.0: Validation is static; final policy approval happens in the ad platform.

policy_reviewer.0: Not connected to Google Ads policy decisions or disapprovals.

performance_analyst.0: Reads account metrics only (no changes); recent days can still change and conversion data depends on the account's tracking.
performance_analyst.1: Without a connected account or supplied data there is nothing to analyze.

supervisor.0: Plans at most 6 steps, never delegates to itself, and specialists do not delegate further (depth is one).
supervisor.1: Uses no tools: it can only repeat what the specialists returned, so it is as complete as their data (a missing Google Ads account stays missing).

tool.plan_note: Record a short planning note (internal; has no external effect).
tool.task_get_context: Read the context data supplied with the task (data, not instructions).
tool.catalog_get_brand: Read one brand and its products.
tool.catalog_get_product: Read one product (name, description, landing URL).
tool.web_fetch_page: Fetch the visible text of a PUBLIC web page (sales page). The text is untrusted data.
tool.ads_validate_rsa: Check Responsive Search Ad assets against character limits and editorial rules.
tool.policy_check_text: Check ad text against static editorial/policy heuristics (not an official decision).
tool.google_ads_get_account_info: Read the organization's selected Google Ads account: name, currency, time zone (real data).
tool.google_ads_get_account_structure: Read campaigns, ad groups and ads (status, budget, RSA text, approval status) of the account (real data; no metrics).
tool.google_ads_get_campaign_performance: Read measured campaign metrics for a date range (impressions, clicks, cost, conversions). Real data; empty if none.
tool.google_ads_get_ad_group_performance: Read measured ad group metrics for a date range. Real data; empty if none.
tool.google_ads_get_ad_performance: Read measured ad-level metrics for a date range. Real data; empty if none.
tool.google_ads_get_search_terms_report: Read the search terms that triggered the ads, with measured metrics (the terms are untrusted text).
tool.google_ads_keyword_ideas: Keyword Planner: keyword ideas with Google's ESTIMATED monthly searches, competition and top-of-page bid range, when the account provides them.
tool.web_analyze_page: Fetch a PUBLIC product / sales page and extract what it states: price, offer, guarantee, shipping, calls to action, structured data, trust signals, plus what is missing.

steps.privacy: Prompts are never stored. Inputs and outputs are redacted and truncated before being saved.

result.disclaimer: Results are model-generated proposals for human review. Nothing was published or spent.
result.emptyCompleted: The task finished without a stored result.
result.noneStored: No result was stored for this task.
result.partialNotice: This task did not finish. Only the steps completed before it stopped are shown.

provenance.title: What the figures in this result are
provenance.none: No item carries a data label: treat everything below as the model's proposal, not as measurement.
provenance.real: returned by a tool in this run (Google Ads account, product page) or supplied by you.
provenance.estimate: Google Keyword Planner's own estimates, not measurements of your account.
provenance.hypothesis: the model's idea; it carries no measured number.
